storyInfo: With combined efforts, Anna soon uncovers that Pavlovich is backed by none other than Olga's own father, Duke Treplev. Olga tries to flee the theater, only to be caught by Anna. In the end, she finally wakes up to where her true responsibilities lies.

attributes.content: Baryshnya Trepleva, it is quite clear to all present that Anna Morozova usurped your authority that night.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I am curious, however, as to why you did not choose to leave the Assembly, like other students did.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: That's because—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Your Honor, I believe the hearing should focus on specific events.
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: ...The atmosphere at the time had compromised my reason.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: In that case, you must explain why you split from Anna's group, and how they kidnapped and coerced you.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: ...Yes, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Virtually everyone stayed at the theater that night, helping those who were injured, and thinking of ways to find out about those who were arrested.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: But the situation changed the following day—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: ...Alright, Olga, I applied what medicine I could find.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: It may not look good, but bear with me, it'll help you heal.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: You're on duty today? Where's Lada?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: You went to bed early last night. Natalya showed up later, along with a Vulpo I didn't know. They took Lada away after talking to Anna's group for a while.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Where's everyone else? The theater's all empty.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'm not sure, but I think Anna assigned missions.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: ...Our priority is to figure out where the students are being held captive.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Start with this list and talk to their parents, it may help us find a way.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I'll talk to my family contacts. Let me know if you have a lead; I'll verify it.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Take care, Anna.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Hm? What are you two doing here?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Olga was sleeping by the stage last night. I saw her wake up when I came to the theater in the morning, so I reapplied her medicine.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: ...Very good.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Sergo, help me move Olga to the rehearsal studio on the third floor. She needs rest.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Perhaps I should go home, Anna.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'm good enough to walk now. I can't promise my father can help get people off, but at least I can ask where they're being held.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Don't worry, I already have a lead on where they're held.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: As for you, you should stay put and focus on recuperating. People will talk if you go home like this.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: There are other injured students staying behind to receive treatment. I'm having someone deliver their letters to their families.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I'll get the stretcher, Olga.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: They moved me into a room, claiming to be protecting me.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: But I soon realized that their 'protection' involved students standing at my door around the clock in shifts with fireman's axes in hand.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: When I tried to talk to them, I was told that they were under orders not to interact with me... so I gave up on writing to my father, because there was no way they would help me send it.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: So you realized you were being held captive by Anna Morozova?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Do you know her motivation to do such a thing?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: My guess is that I expressed reluctance when she hinted at exploiting the nobility the previous night.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Do you think it explains the Ursus Student Self-Government Group's hostility towards the aristocracy? It would be consistent with Sonya Mykhailivna colluding with the Unbound.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: ...Yes.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I wasn't the only one she imprisoned. Anyone who wasn't sufficiently firm in resolve, whom she deemed an information risk as well as... nobles who had value to her, were all treated the same way.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Did you have any opportunity to communicate with the outside or leave the room?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Very little, except for Sergo, who quietly told me what the students were doing when he was on duty, even telling me—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: ...Are you sure about this?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Absolutely! My mother has been running a garment factory in Grypherburg for more than a decade. You can trust us on this.
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: But she said that approximately nine hundred winter army uniforms were being transported to the quarantine zone, while Natalya's observations yesterday indicates that there are no more than five hundred combatants there.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: If both of you are right, then there can only be one explanation—someone is sending reinforcements into the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Sonya just said they couldn't deal with heavy weapons, and now reinforcements are being sent? What do we do, Anna?
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: Will your mother be at the factory these couple of days?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Yes, why?
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: I will speak to my police contacts, get a few uniforms, put some tall boys in them, and go to your mother's factory disguised as the gendarmes auditing the books.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Tell your mother that you don't have class for a few days, so you're helping out at the factory. Put in a word for us if your mother gets suspicious, tell her letting the cops see the books won't do any harm.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Uh...
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: No hesitation. Our friends are in graver danger with every passing second. Trust my judgment, if you want to save them.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: The source of this order is the breakthrough that we've been waiting for.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: But impersonating the cops... that's way too hard.
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: We haven't been in contact with our comms girl Botani since the ball, but the equipment that she left behind still works.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Bring the equipment and follow my orders. My friend who has police connections will be there to help...
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Sergo, are you there?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You're the tallest, you'll be the first to try the uniforms.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Me? But I get all red in the face whenever I go onstage in drama club. No way I could—
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: ...Play a cop.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Wow, my whole face is covered up...
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Stop talking to yourself, Sergo. Watch the office door and don't let anyone come in.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Gotcha, Anna.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Do not respond verbally.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: He nods reflexively, his throat moving up and down underneath his mask. He has had to swallow three times in the span of a single minute.
Anna's friend still has her head buried in the pile of documents on the office desk. Everything is going smoother than he expected, except for the part where he actually finds the answer.
Why is it taking so long—
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: What do you mean, taking so long...?
Wait, who are you? I thought we were supposed to be checking the books today—Unit 2.
Sergo turns around to find an authentic, non-impostor Ursine policeman staring at him perplexedly, or so he infers through the policeman's goggles.
He covers his mouth by reflex, although his counterpart would never have detected his anxiety if he did not do so.
What's your district and unit? Did the new superintendent mix up the orders again?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Uh, uh, uh—
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Are you not feeling well? There's no fireplace or heating here. Why are you sweating like that...?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Slap him, Sergo.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: ...Huh?
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Do it. My friend's coming your way.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Slap him, then yell at the top of your lungs, 'Do not delay the daughter of Lord Yaroslav!'
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: ...Do not delay the daughter of Lord Yaroslav!
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: He slaps the man with all his strength, and has to stop himself from crying out at the pain of his stinging palm.
The man stands where he is, reaching up to touch where he was slapped.
I apologize. The superintendent made a last-minute change, and the news apparently didn't reach you.
attributes.name: Anna's Friend

attributes.content: This man is my bodyguard, whom my family arranged to go into the service with me, for father was uneasy about me being alone.
attributes.name: Anna's Friend

attributes.content: ...So it's like that again?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Yes, like that.
attributes.name: Anna's Friend

attributes.content: Command knew this factory's books were off, so they left it to some noble kid to reap the fruits.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: I've been in the force for three years, and it's the same every year. Every time there's a new superintendent, a bunch of people come in you don't dare to touch.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: This is Grypherburg, after all.
attributes.name: Anna's Friend

attributes.content: Wait!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: ...Give your father my regards. I'd appreciate it even more if you gave him my name and number.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: The cop just walked away without saying another thing! I should've slapped him harder.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: That's incredible, Sergo.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: But you were telling me that the books revealed that it was the House of Treplev that was supporting the magistrate behind the scenes, and planning to send reinforcements?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Yes. Anna and Natalya talked for a long time last night about your family and friends, especially your father.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: How do they know my associates?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Anna arranged for a few students to return home and go back to school like nothing happened.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: You know the Assembly has students from practically every school. We talked to friends and teachers of those who were arrested. There are many people who care about them, and so we got a lot of information.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Someone said she's already located the Treplev estate and is planning to lay an ambush for the duke. All hearsay and rumors amongst the students, of course—
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Olga... I know this isn't fair to you.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: I see no option other than to accept.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'm trapped here with no way to stop whatever they're trying to do. I can only hope for the best.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Mm...
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: I'm glad you see things that way. I'll let you get your rest.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Say, you said you were going to sew a flag for the Assembly and wanted me to collect various kinds of fabric. Have you finished it?
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: I'm sure Anna would want to come and talk to you, if I showed her the flag you made.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: I'll tell you when I'm done.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Sure! Good night, Olga.
attributes.name: Sergo

attributes.content: Olga exhales as the door closes silently.

She takes out a long rope tied together from fabric of many different colors, and ties one end to the heavy bed frame made of solid wood. She tugs on it a few times, making sure that it can bear her weight.
Then she goes over to the window and throws the other end out. The rope is immediately swallowed up by the night, as though it has fallen into a bottomless abyss.
I'm sorry, Sergo. I hope Anna won't be too hard on you.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: ...I won't be making your flag.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.text: I didn't dare to go home after escaping the theater. I didn't dare to face my father, though he was sure to forgive everything, and I was afraid of the rumored ambush.
I went back to school, looking for someone I could rely on. Professor Valeriya took me in—out of respect for the House of Treplev.
I spent the longest winter night in the professor's dormitory.

attributes.content: ...You must be mistaken.
attributes.name: Ursine Professor

attributes.content: I understand your wish to protect your students, Professor Valeriya.
However, Olga is not the only student at this school. We need her to help the students who are being held captive.
Please—
The faint silhouette outside the winter suddenly turns its head. Its gaze seems to pierce the thick frosted glass, immediately driving the sleepiness from Olga's head.

She leaps from the bed, not even having the time to put on her shoes, and runs through the back door up the stairs. In her terror, she dares not turn around, even as the footsteps and shouting behind her grow louder.
*Pant*—*Pant*—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: S-Stay away!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I should have known. Sergo is gentle-hearted, but prone to naivete. He was always likely to make a mistake.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: There is still time to rectify the mistake, however.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: How did you find me? Do you even have spies in our school?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: These past few days, I combed every school in Grypherburg for potential allies, following the list of missing students.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You sought sanctuary at your school as soon as you escaped the theater... you're exactly who I think you are.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Where else could I go? Sergo told me you have assassins hiding around my home.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Is it true that you're trying to kill my father?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I have neither the intention nor the ability to deal with the Ursine aristocracy that way. We have always operated by negotiation.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I believed you when you promised to rescue the students that night, because I felt guilty about what happened to them.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: But what did you do to me? Tricked me and locked me up in a room! Did you think I'd still trust you?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I don't know where you heard these rumors—
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Stay away from me!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Olga stumbles back a few steps, leaning against the windowsill at the end of the stairway, her hands pressed against the window frame.
I've had enough, Anna!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I-I don't want my father to be purged because of me, but I can't just watch my fellow students die either.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I just want all this to end! If you'll only be satisfied by making me—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Calm down! Think this through. If anything happens to you, it would be a catastrophe for both your father and the students!
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: The duke would lose his daughter and heir. He would stop at nothing for revenge, to crush us, and everyone in the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: No, no, I just—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I don't know what to do!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Oh—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: The cold wind tears at Olga's shawl, threatening to devour her. Suddenly, her arms lose their strength, and she loses her balance, falling backwards out of the window.
Olga—
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: ...I was lucky to fall right into the middle of the pile. I escaped from Morozova with only minor injuries.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I hid in the city for a day, until my father's men found me and took me home.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: That is the extent of my account.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: The chamber is once again filled with chatter, though a single sigh stands out, as though a tremendous weight has been lifted off one pair of shoulders.
Baryshnya Trepleva, from your point of view, how did the students enter the Treplev estate?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I don't know how they did it, but given that Anna already knew where it was, they would have had their pick of options.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Well... I'm sure the entire committee has arrived at an answer.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Still, I must follow protocol and confirm this—
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Baryshnya Trepleva, do you accuse Anna Morozova, leader of the Student Assembly, of colluding with Sonya Mykhailivna, and committing various crimes, including treason?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I accuse the leader of the Student Assembly...
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Olga Danilovna Trepleva, of responsibility for all acts involving the students in the Katorga Incident.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Wait—
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: Anna Morozova should be penalized for blackmailing the nobility, but she only did what she did out of urgent necessity—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Do you know what you are saying, Baryshnya Trepleva?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I am stating the truth, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Ever since Zoya took the stand, everyone in the room knew the source of the storm, yet no one was willing to say her name.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Who was the leader and organizer of the Student Assembly, who pushed it down this path, who is responsible for this broken order...
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I declare that I shall willingly don the shackles I deserve—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Recess! Recess!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Stop writing, parliamentarian! Escort Baryshnya Trepleva out for fresh air, now!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The testimony once again sets the hearing on fire. The roaring of the duke and the animated discussions quickly drown out the feeble hammering of the gavel.
Olga lowers her gaze as she is escorted out by the parliamentarian, past Absinthe on the witness stand.
Absinthe nods slightly.
Hah—hah——
Get, up, here!
...What?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'm not letting go! Stay put!
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Istina is leaning out the window, both hands locked around Olga's arms, hanging on with all her might.
The others rush forward to pull Istina and Olga back into the hallway in a chorus of heave-hos and panting.
Hah—
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You can't die here, Olga. Didn't you hear what I said?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: But, I could never be, as ruthless as you are—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Ruthless?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Tell me, were you really planning to jump when you were sitting on that windowsill?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Your problem was never that you couldn't be ruthless. You were simply running away.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: When you decided to hold the protest, and now... you were fearless in opposing everything, simply because you knew—
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: No matter what you did, all you needed to do was to turn around, and you would find yourself in your father's embrace.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You never knew what it felt like to struggle to survive, you never even imagined it. You simply dreamed one day after another, in the cradle that your family has woven for you...
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Do you think all the other people in the land of Ursus get to dream the same dream?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Let me tell you this, Olga.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You have never truly seen your country, seen Ursus for what it is. Innocence is a sin in this land, and indecision its greatest accomplice, but you have continued to avoid choosing your path.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: If you wanted to continue to dream, you should have gone back to your father a long time ago, and sat by the warm fireside watching the executioner's axe fall on our futures.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: If you want to rescue the students, you need to put all your chips on the table, even your own family.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I have already made my choice... stand up, Olga.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I'm taking you back, whether you like it or not. I will show you how we get the others out of the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: We have to go, Anna. We've already caused quite the commotion on campus. The students helping us can only delay them for so long.
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: ...Let's go back to the theater.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Students can't remain students forever, Olga. Everyone has something that they must do... and what I must do now is make you disappear for a while.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You will be freed once the situation has been resolved.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: ...One moment, Anna.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: You know where the Treplev estate is...
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Yes, but I have no intention of killing your father. I only want to convince him.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: To save the students?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: ...I have an idea.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: There is a secret passage that leads to the manor's wine cellar, accessible through the warehouse of a vineyard on the western outskirts of Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: It is my father's escape route in the event of an assassination attempt... not even the guards know about it. You can enter the manor through there, and he will know at once that it was I who told you about it.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Olga...
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You understand that this will ruin your relationship with your family beyond repair.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: No, Anna.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I will defend my honor and that of my house, in my own way.
attributes.name: Olga
